name: Sound of Broken Bells
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level bard 4, cleric/oracle 4

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F/DF (a broken bell)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 15-ft.-radius spread
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You ring the broken bell and the affected area is filled with a painful clangor of bells. Each creature in the area is dealt 1d4 sonic damage per caster level (maximum 10d4) and the target is deafened for 2d6 rounds. A successful Fortitude save negates the deafness and halves the sonic damage.
